newsitem.title: USA: National Computer helped by interest income.
newsitem.headline: National Computer helped by interest income.

text.p: Higher interest income helped National Computer Systems Inc post solid gains in quarterly operating income on Wednesday, an analyst said.

The Minneapolis-based company, which designs and markets information systems for banking and educational markets, posted net income from continuing operations of $5.0 million from $3.8 million in the third quarter. Total revenues in the period rose 11 percent to $88.8 million.
"They outperformed our projection because of the higher interest income," said Michael Sabbann, an analyst at Piper Jaffray.
"However, we're not recommending buying heavily into the stock until their acquisition strategy is made a little more clear."
National Computer Systems has said it planned to expand into system integration and information processing businesses, Sabbann said.
Chairman, president and chief executive officer, Russell Gullotti said the company's balance sheet would allow it to pursue internal growth and strategic acquisitions in several key areas.
"We are hopeful of completing transactions in the next several quarters," he said.
The company earlier this month disclosed plans to acquire Macro Educational Systems Inc, a developer of software for grade school and high school administrators, in a deal valued at $14 million.
